## What would you like to see added?

A clear description of the feature or improvement.

## What kind of contribution is this?

- [ ] New training mode
- [ ] New language / word list
- [ ] UI / UX improvement
- [ ] Other (describe below)

## Why would this be useful?

Explain the use case — who benefits and how.

## Additional context

Mockups, examples from other typing test sites, or anything else that
helps explain the idea.
